phases.objective: Fail closed when active E2E contracts or their implemented evidence references are changed, deleted, renamed, missing, untracked, non-regular, symbolic, or path-escaping, including reverse dependency impact from modified referenced files.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Exact-head changed-file diff plus repository E2E contract index
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Changed contracts and unchanged contracts affected by modified, deleted, or renamed evidence are targeted and verified; historical unrelated debt remains outside the PR blocker unless full-audit mode is explicitly requested.
steps: Build the exact add/modify/delete/rename set from base...head.
Index Spec and non-Spec E2E contracts and their implemented journey evidence paths.
Reverse-map deleted and renamed references to every unchanged contract that still points at the retired path.
Reverse-map modified references to every unchanged contract that depends on the changed path.
Target the union of changed contracts and reference-affected contracts.
Resolve each targeted evidence path inside the repository and reject missing, symbolic, non-regular, or deleted evidence.
Publish impacted_contracts, modified_reference_affected_contracts, and unverified_impacted_contract_count in canonical machine-readable evidence.
Run Git-index integrity for tracked stage-zero regular-file proof and keep explicit full-audit mode separate from PR ratcheting.
assertions: A changed E2E contract cannot bypass evidence validation.
Deleting or renaming an E2E contract fails closed and requires explicit reviewed retirement.
Deleting or renaming evidence targets every implemented contract that still references the old path.
Modifying referenced evidence targets every implemented contract that references that path even when the contract file itself is unchanged.
The report exposes modified_reference_affected_contracts and unverified_impacted_contract_count.
Targeted evidence must remain inside the repository, regular, non-symbolic, and present on the candidate head.
Unrelated historical drift is not silently widened into the current pull-request blocker; explicit full-audit mode remains available.
The workflow is read-only, exact-head, credential-nonpersisting, and grants no database, provider, deployment, protected-ref, force-push, or Production authority.

phases.objective: Publish trusted pull-request summaries and observe modified-reference impact counts before tightening server enforcement.
Add explicit reviewed contract-retirement and reference-migration protocols for historical debt cleanup.
The guard operates entirely on repository contracts and has no external canary target.
The guard does not deploy, apply migrations, call providers, or mutate Production.
